tbesh_html:
1) to lay aside, reserve, withdraw, withhold
1a) (Qal) to reserve, set apart, withhold
1b) (Niphal) to be withdrawn
1c) (Hiphil) to withdraw

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to separate; hence, to select, refuse, contract
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root; properly, to join; used only as a denominative from H681 (אֵצֶל);
